### [PdfFileDrop.tsx](file:///c%3A/Users/demig/Documents/vulcano/vulcano-fe/src/components/PdfFileDrop.tsx)

Crea un nuovo componente che consente di allegare PDF tramite click o drag and drop, mostrando il nome del file selezionato.

````tsx
import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";

interface PdfFileDropProps {
  onFileSelect: (file: File | null) => void;
}

const PdfFileDrop: React.FC<PdfFileDropProps> = ({ onFileSelect }) => {
  const [dragActive, setDragActive] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleFile = (file: File | null) => {
    if (file && file.type === "application/pdf") {
      setSelectedFile(file);
      onFileSelect(file);
    } else {
      setSelectedFile(null);
      onFileSelect(null);
    }
  };

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0] || null;
    handleFile(file);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragActive(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0] || null;
    handleFile(file);
  };

  return (
    <div
      onDragOver={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragActive(true); }}
      onDragLeave={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragActive(false); }}
      onDrop={handleDrop}
      style={{
        border: dragActive ? "2px solid #1976d2" : "2px dashed #bdbdbd",
        borderRadius: 8,
        padding: 10,
        background: dragActive ? "#e3f2fd" : "#fafbfc",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        gap: 8,
        minWidth: 180,
        minHeight: 40,
        cursor: "pointer"
      }}
      onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
      title="Trascina qui un PDF o clicca per selezionare"
    >
      <input
        type="file"
        accept="application/pdf"
        style={{ display: "none" }}
        ref={fileInputRef}
        onChange={handleChange}
      />
      <span role="img" aria-label="allega">📎</span>
      {selectedFile ? (
        <span style={{ fontSize: "0.95em" }}>{selectedFile.name}</span>
      ) : (
        <span style={{ color: "#888", fontSize: "0.95em" }}>
          Trascina o clicca per PDF
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default PdfFileDrop;
````

### [ChatInput.tsx](file:///c%3A/Users/demig/Documents/vulcano/vulcano-fe/src/components/ChatInput.tsx)

Sostituisci la zona accanto al tasto "Invia" con il nuovo componente PdfFileDrop, che gestisce anche il drag and drop.

````tsx
import React, { useState } from "react";
import PdfFileDrop from "./PdfFileDrop";
// ...existing code...

const ChatInput: React.FC = () => {
    const [input, setInput] = useState("");
    const [pdfFile, setPdfFile] = useState<File | null>(null);

    const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (input.trim()) {
            console.log("Domanda inviata:", input);
            if (pdfFile) {
                console.log("PDF allegato:", pdfFile.name);
            }
            setInput("");
            setPdfFile(null);
        }
    };

    return (
        <form
            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
            className="chat-window-form"
            style={{
                background: "#f7f7fa",
                borderRadius: "12px",
                padding: "12px",
                boxShadow: "0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)",
                border: "1px solid #e0e0e0"
            }}
        >
            <textarea
                value={input}
                onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Scrivi la tua domanda..."
                className="chat-window"
                rows={2}
                wrap="soft"
            />
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                <button type="submit">Invia</button>
                <PdfFileDrop onFileSelect={setPdfFile} />
            </div>
        </form>
    );
};

export default ChatInput;
````

### [PdfFileDrop.tsx](file:///c%3A/Users/demig/Documents/vulcano/vulcano-fe/src/components/PdfFileDrop.tsx)

Rimuovi eventuali style inline e usa solo le classi CSS.

````tsx
````tsx
import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";
import '../styles/main.scss';

interface PdfFileDropProps {
  onFileSelect: (file: File | null) => void;
}

const PdfFileDrop: React.FC<PdfFileDropProps> = ({ onFileSelect }) => {
  const [dragActive, setDragActive] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleFile = (file: File | null) => {
    if (file && file.type === "application/pdf") {
      setSelectedFile(file);
      onFileSelect(file);
    } else {
      setSelectedFile(null);
      onFileSelect(null);
    }
  };

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0] || null;
    handleFile(file);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragActive(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0] || null;
    handleFile(file);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`pdf-file-drop${dragActive ? " drag-active" : ""}`}
      onDragOver={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragActive(true); }}
      onDragLeave={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragActive(false); }}
      onDrop={handleDrop}
      onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
      title="Trascina qui un PDF o clicca per selezionare"
    >
      <input
        type="file"
        accept="application/pdf"
        className="pdf-file-drop-input"
        ref={fileInputRef}
        onChange={handleChange}
        tabIndex={-1}
      />
      <span role="img" aria-label="allega">📎</span>
      {selectedFile ? (
        <span className="pdf-file-drop__filename">{selectedFile.name}</span>
      ) : (
        <span className="pdf-file-drop__placeholder">
          Trascina o clicca per PDF
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default PdfFileDrop;
````

**Nota:** L'input file ora ha la classe `pdf-file-drop-input`. Aggiungi questo stile in `main.scss`:

````scss
// ...existing code...

.pdf-file-drop-input {
  display: none;
}

// ...existing code...
````

Modifica la logica per mostrare il drag and drop solo se non c'è un PDF selezionato. Se c'è un PDF, mostra il nome e un bottone per rimuoverlo.

````

**Spiegazione:**  
- Il drag and drop (`PdfFileDrop`) viene mostrato solo se non c'è un PDF selezionato (`!pdfFile`).
- Se c'è un PDF selezionato, viene mostrato il nome del file e un bottone "×" per rimuoverlo.
- In questo modo, il drag and drop scompare dopo il caricamento di un PDF.

### [ChatInput.tsx](file:///c%3A/Users/demig/Documents/vulcano/vulcano-fe/src/components/ChatInput.tsx)

Simula l'elaborazione PDF con uno "sleep" e passa la percentuale di caricamento a `PdfFileDrop`. Mostra la percentuale durante il finto caricamento.

````tsx
import React, { useState } from "react";
import PdfFileDrop from "./PdfFileDrop";
// ...existing code...

const ChatInput: React.FC = () => {
    const [input, setInput] = useState("");
    const [pdfFile, setPdfFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
    const [showPdfDrop, setShowPdfDrop] = useState(false);
    const [loadingPercent, setLoadingPercent] = useState<number>(0);

    const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (input.trim()) {
            console.log("Domanda inviata:", input);
            if (pdfFile) {
                console.log("PDF allegato:", pdfFile.name);
            }
            setInput("");
            setPdfFile(null);
            setShowPdfDrop(false);
            setLoadingPercent(0);
        }
    };

    const handlePdfSelect = async (file: File | null) => {
        if (file) {
            setLoadingPercent(1);
            // Simula caricamento con percentuale
            for (let i = 1; i <= 100; i += 5) {
                await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 20));
                setLoadingPercent(i);
            }
            console.log("PDF selezionato:", file.name);
            setPdfFile(file);
            setShowPdfDrop(false);
            setLoadingPercent(0);
        }
    };

    return (
        <form
            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
            className="chat-window-form chat-input-form"
        >
            <div className="chat-input-row">
                <button
                    type="button"
                    className={`chat-input-togglepdf${showPdfDrop ? " active" : ""}`}
                    onClick={() => {
                        setShowPdfDrop((prev) => !prev);
                        setPdfFile(null);
                        setLoadingPercent(0);
                    }}
                    aria-label={showPdfDrop ? "Nascondi PDF" : "Allega PDF"}
                >
                    {showPdfDrop ? "−" : "+"}
                </button>
                <textarea
                    value={input}
                    onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Scrivi la tua domanda..."
                    className="chat-window"
                    rows={2}
                    wrap="soft"
                />
                <button type="submit">Invia</button>
            </div>
            {showPdfDrop && (
                <div className="chat-input-pdfdrop">
                    <div className="chat-input-pdfdrop-inner">
                        <PdfFileDrop
                            onFileSelect={handlePdfSelect}
                            loadingPercent={loadingPercent}
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </form>
    );
};

export default ChatInput;
````

### [PdfFileDrop.tsx](file:///c%3A/Users/demig/Documents/vulcano/vulcano-fe/src/components/PdfFileDrop.tsx)

Accetta la prop `loadingPercent` e mostra la percentuale se > 0.

````tsx
import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";
import '../styles/main.scss';

interface PdfFileDropProps {
  onFileSelect: (file: File | null) => void;
  loadingPercent?: number;
}

const PdfFileDrop: React.FC<PdfFileDropProps> = ({ onFileSelect, loadingPercent = 0 }) => {
  const [dragActive, setDragActive] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [errorUpload, setErrorUpload] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleFile = (file: File | null) => {
    if (file && file.type === "application/pdf") {
      setErrorUpload(null);
      setSelectedFile(file);
      onFileSelect(file);
    } else {
      setErrorUpload("Per favore carica un file PDF valido.");
      setSelectedFile(null);
      onFileSelect(null);
    }
  };

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0] || null;
    handleFile(file);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragActive(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0] || null;
    handleFile(file);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`pdf-file-drop${dragActive ? " drag-active" : ""}`}
      onDragOver={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragActive(true); }}
      onDragLeave={e => { e.preventDefault(); setDragActive(false); }}
      onDrop={handleDrop}
      onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
      title="Trascina qui un PDF o clicca per selezionare"
    >
      <input
        type="file"
        accept="application/pdf"
        className="pdf-file-drop-input"
        ref={fileInputRef}
        onChange={handleChange}
        tabIndex={-1}
      />
      <span role="img" aria-label="allega">📎</span>
      <span>
        {loadingPercent > 0 ? (
          <span className="pdf-file-drop__loading">
            Caricamento... {loadingPercent}%
          </span>
        ) : selectedFile ? (
          <span className="pdf-file-drop__filename">{selectedFile.name}</span>
        ) : errorUpload ? (
          <span className="pdf-file-drop__error">{errorUpload}</span>
        ) : (
          <span className="pdf-file-drop__placeholder">
            Trascina o clicca per PDF
          </span>
        )}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
};

export default PdfFileDrop;
````
